name: Discord Bot Channel
description: Discord Bot integration for ActonOS AI agents with rich embeds, multi-account gateway, and agent routing
author: ActonOS Core Team

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Time delay in seconds between consecutive message processing cycles

accounts.title: Discord Bot Accounts
accounts.description: Configure one or multiple Discord bot accounts for simultaneous Gateway listening

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this bot account

discord_bot_token.title: Discord Bot Token
discord_bot_token.description: Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal (securely stored in Hardware Vault)

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

listen_channel_id.title: Listen Channel ID (Optional)
listen_channel_id.description: Specific Discord Channel ID to restrict listening (leave empty to listen to all channels)

enable_embeds.title: Enable Rich Embeds
enable_embeds.description: Format outbound replies using Discord rich embeds
